reviews.comment: This class is the easiest A imaginable, but I recommend going to the classes as he's a great lecturer and has some very interesting topics in this class that might interest you without even needing to go. He also gave everyone an A if you had a class avg over 40. Exams are easy because they are the same as the practice exams he gives out.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Stripling is a dawg. It's obvious that he cares about his students and their opinions. Take any class he teaches if you have the chance.

Stripling is genuinely the best professor I have ever had. As far as material goes, he doesn't throw you any curveballs and prepares you well for the exam. His lectures actually make you want to be there, he is passionate about what he is teaching. Outside of that, he is just a great person. He understands that we are human and he is so caring.
Easily the best professor I've had at A&M, so caring and wants everyone to succeed. I've taken 2 classes with him and wish I could take more. If you have the chance to take his classes, take them!!

Professor Stripping is the most caring and understandable professor at Texas A&M. He is very approachable and will always look out to support you if you aren't doing great in his class. Attendance policy is very understanding and you only have to go to class if you want to be exempt for this class. I also took Econ 315 with him and it was great!

Stripling is the goat! I am graduating this semester and have had many different professors and he is by far the best! I could have easily gotten an A by trying more but senioritis was real. Pay attention in lectures and you should be fine.

Professor Stripling is no doubt the best professor I have had. He is always willing to help to make sure you understand material clearly and explains it in a way that is easy to comprehend. I have had him for multiple classes and have had the same experience in all! 100% would take any class he teaches.

Sam always wanted the best for his students. He would always ask the class for feedback and adjust his teaching according to his students'k feedback. I enjoyed attending his class and would definitely take his class again. You have to pay attention in his class if you want to do decent.

Professor Stripling is so amazing! He is a genuinely caring professor who wants you to succeed. He spends ample time explaining the expectations in his course, and, being a newer Prof, accepts feedback and incorporates student's opinions seamlessly. He also provides strong resources to study and understands we have other courses.

One of the most receptive teachers I've ever had- he cares a lot about his students' feedback and if they're following along. Unsure if my grade will be a B+ or an A yet. Stripling makes material pretty easy to comprehend, but sometimes it's hard to keep focus during long lectures. Reviewing the textbook and homework on your own helps tremendously.

This class was advertised as one of the hardest Econ classes I would ever take. That couldn't be further from the truth w professor stripling. He is very accommodating and kind. Answers emails quickly and takes feedback from the class frequently on what he can improve on. Even gave us extra credit after TAMU won fb games.
